description: `GET /v1/messages/batches/{message_batch_id}/results` answers 200 with a `.jsonl` file as `application/x-jsonl` (one `MessageBatchIndividualResponse` JSON object per line). The converter reads only JSON bodies, so the operation returns nothing. The official SDKs read this response as binary (`__binaryResponse: true` in anthropics/anthropic-sdk-typescript) and split it into lines. Model the body as a raw `Blob` payload so the call returns the file's bytes as a `Uint8Array`.
